Object Text: The network shall provide marine weather observations for the coastal region it covers.
Name: Coastal coverage

Object Text: Forecasters shall receive observations in time to use them in the next bulletin.
Name: Timely observations

Object Text: Mariners shall be able to read the latest bulletin and observations from a public service.
Name: Public access

Object Text: Field crews shall be able to service any station from a single service vessel.
Name: Serviceable in the field

Object Text: Past observations shall be kept so earlier conditions can be reviewed.
Name: Observation history

Object Text: Offshore stations shall keep observing without shore power.
Name: Off-grid operation

Object Text: Each station shall measure wind, air pressure and air temperature, and each buoy shall also measure waves.
Name: Measure conditions

Object Text: Each station shall transmit its observations to the data center on a fixed schedule.
Name: Scheduled transmission

Object Text: The data center shall ingest every observation it receives.
Name: Ingest

Object Text: The data center shall flag observations that fail a quality check.
Name: Quality control

Object Text: The data center shall archive every observation together with its quality flag.
Name: Archive

Object Text: The data center shall publish a marine bulletin twice a day, on a fixed schedule.
Name: Bulletin

Object Text: The public service shall show the latest observation from every station.
Name: Latest observations

Object Text: Stations shall send observations to the data center over the observation interface.
Name: Observation interface

Object Text: Stations shall report their health to the data center over the health interface.
Name: Health reporting

Object Text: The data center shall offer observations through a documented public interface.
Name: Public interface

Object Text: Each buoy shall run from its own solar panel and battery.
Name: Own power

Object Text: Every station shall be serviceable from the service vessel.
Name: Vessel access

Object Text: Each station shall keep observations it could not send and send them once the link returns.
Name: Store and forward

Object Text: Each station shall report its operating mode.
Name: Operating mode

Object Text: The data center shall keep a log of every bulletin it published.
Name: Bulletin log

Object Text: All stations and the data center shall use a common time reference.
Name: Common time

Object Text: The buoy hull shall carry the sensor suite above the waterline.
Name: Sensor height

Object Text: The mooring shall keep the buoy within its assigned watch circle.
Name: Watch circle

Object Text: The power system shall report the battery state of charge.
Name: State of charge

Object Text: The telemetry unit shall retry a failed transmission.
Name: Retry

Object Text: The ingest service shall discard duplicate observations.
Name: Duplicates

Object Text: The quality control service shall record why an observation was flagged.
Name: Flag reason

Object Text: The archive shall return any observation by station and time.
Name: Retrieval

Object Text: The publisher shall stamp each bulletin with its issue time.
Name: Issue time
